vulnerability.name: GHSA-hh8m-fm6v-7cvg
vulnerability.description: Angular: Sanitization bypass via directive host bindings on concrete host elements in @angular/core and @angular/compiler

statements.status_notes: provider=copilot confidence=0.95 evidence=version_vulnerable,direct_dependency,osv_details | The installed version 22.0.8 is vulnerable (below fixed version 22.1.0) and is a direct dependency of the product. No evidence of workarounds or mitigations is provided, and reachability analysis is unavailable for npm packages. The vulnerability in Angular's directive host binding sanitization poses a real risk if bomhort uses this feature with user-controlled values.
statements.action_statement: Upgrade @angular/compiler to version 22.1.0 or later to patch the sanitization bypass vulnerability.

vulnerability.name: GHSA-p297-fm68-3q8c
vulnerability.description: Angular: Information Leak via `HttpTransferCache` Bypass When Using `withRequestsMadeViaParent`

statements.status_notes: provider=copilot confidence=0.9 evidence=version_vulnerable,direct_dependency,osv_details | The product contains @angular/common@22.0.8, which is below the fixed version 22.1.1. The package is a direct dependency of bomhort, meaning the vulnerable code is present and in use. While the specific vulnerability requires SSR with hierarchical HttpClient and withRequestsMadeViaParent() configuration, the presence of the vulnerable version in a direct dependency creates an exploitability risk.
statements.action_statement: Upgrade @angular/common to version 22.1.1 or later to remediate the HttpTransferCache bypass vulnerability.
